description: Schedule a process to run automatically on a recurring cadence -- hourly, daily, or weekly -- in a named timezone. This is real autonomy: once created and enabled, OTP runs the SOP on its own and the run spends the organization's wallet, with no human in the session. Call list_processes first and pass the exact agent_external_id and sop_title it returned. Cadence is limited to hourly/daily/weekly by design; there is no raw cron and no weekdays-only option, so say so plainly rather than approximating one. Requires a funded wallet and an active API key.

agent_external_id.description: The seat that owns the process, exactly as list_processes returned it (e.g. 'AGT_RADAR')

hour.description: Hour of day, 0-23, in the schedule's timezone. Required for daily and weekly; ignored for hourly. 10 means 10am.

minute.description: Minute of the hour, 0-59. Defaults to 0.

name.description: Label for the schedule. Defaults to the SOP title.

sop_id.description: SOP id when list_processes returned one; more precise than matching on title

sop_title.description: Exact title of the SOP to run, as list_processes returned it

timezone.description: IANA timezone the hour is read in, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Defaults to America/New_York. Ask rather than assume when the user's timezone is not already known.

weekday.description: Day of week for weekly, 0=Sunday through 6=Saturday. Defaults to Monday.

name: create_schedule
